description: This file contains the AssetFlows static class which manages create, read, update, delete, and query operations for assets, including exception handling, request and result record types, and logging. It interacts with a repository for database operations and enforces business rules like uniqueness of Permit EU IDs and parent asset validation.

classes.name: AssetFlows
classes.description: A static class providing orchestration for asset create/read/update/query operations, including exception types and request/response data structures.

classes.name: DuplicatePermitEuIdException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when an attempt is made to create or update an asset with a duplicate Permit EU ID.

methods.name: CreateAssetAsync
methods.description: Creates a new asset, enforcing Permit EU ID uniqueness, and validates parent pseudo asset constraints.

methods.name: GetAssetAsync
methods.description: Fetches an asset by ID, excluding soft-deleted assets.

methods.name: UpdateAssetAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing asset, enforcing Permit EU ID uniqueness and parent asset constraints.

methods.name: QueryAssetsAsync
methods.description: Query assets with optional filters, returning a list of asset data transfer objects.

methods.name: DeleteAssetAsync
methods.description: Performs a soft delete of an asset and its dependent rows, maintaining referential integrity.
